name: OrderBuddy Eval
description: End-to-end LLM eval pipeline by Pawanchander Komuravelli (PM & builder): 10k synthetic support tickets, intent discovery via MiniLM + HDBSCAN, benchmark validation, and a 3-tier Claude bake-off with binary safety/groundedness gates and cost per 1,000 classifications. Evidence before roadmap, evals before demos.
